{{Top|leg}}
The '''Delayan government''' was the ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]].<ref name="hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the Delayan government agreed to house the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited Delaya to assist the refugees, as well as recruit [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] into the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Delayan government agreed to host her without notifying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] of her presence. However, [[Var Lyonn]], the deputy to [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Gresh Manaa]], secretly made a deal with the Empire and disclosed Organa's location.<ref name="hostage" />
